t: Software Dependency Graph Builder: a plain-language overview
title: Software Dependency Graph Builder: a plain-language overview
description: Overview: what the Software Dependency Graph Builder does and why archives need it. A software dependency graph builder reads a project's manifests — package.json, requirements.txt, pom.xml — and draws the full tree of what depends on what, down through every transitive dependency. It finds version conflicts and circular dependencies before they break a build. Every library's family tree, mapped.
provenance: Public methods compiled from standard information-extraction and knowledge-organization practice. Assembled for the JAH Databases archive.

t: How the Software Dependency Graph Builder works
title: How the Software Dependency Graph Builder works
description: Overview: what the Software Dependency Graph Builder does and why archives need it. Real builders parse manifests from each ecosystem (npm, PyPI, Maven, Cargo), resolve version constraints against registries to pick concrete versions, and construct the full transitive graph. Cycle detection flags circular dependencies, conflict detection flags two packages demanding incompatible versions of a third, and lockfiles freeze the resolved graph for reproducibility. The graph powers vulnerability scanning: a CVE in one library instantly reveals every affected project.
provenance: Public methods compiled from standard information-extraction and knowledge-organization practice. Assembled for the JAH Databases archive.

t: How the Software Dependency Graph Builder works: the deep tour
title: How the Software Dependency Graph Builder works: the deep tour
description: Overview: what the Software Dependency Graph Builder does and why archives need it. Real builders parse manifests from each ecosystem (npm, PyPI, Maven, Cargo), resolve version constraints against registries to pick concrete versions, and construct the full transitive graph. Cycle detection flags circular dependencies, conflict detection flags two packages demanding incompatible versions of a third, and lockfiles freeze the resolved graph for reproducibility. The graph powers vulnerability scanning: a CVE in one library instantly reveals every affected project. Advanced builders handle platform-specific and optional dependencies, detect dependency confusion risks (private package names shadowed by public ones), and compute minimal upgrade paths. Quality is measured by resolution fidelity against real package managers. The limits are undeclared dependencies (vendored code, dynamic imports) — the builder reports manifest-vs-reality gaps when it can detect them and marks its graph as manifest-derived, never claiming to see what was never declared.
provenance: Public methods compiled from standard information-extraction and knowledge-organization practice. Assembled for the JAH Databases archive.
